name: sigma-computing-pp-mcp
description: The first full-featured CLI for the Sigma Computing API, plus a local mirror, offline search, and governance audits no other Sigma tool has.

sigma_computing_client_id.title: SIGMA_COMPUTING_CLIENT_ID
sigma_computing_client_id.description: Sets SIGMA_COMPUTING_CLIENT_ID for the Sigma MCP server. Get a credential from https://help.sigmacomputing.com/reference.

sigma_computing_client_secret.title: SIGMA_COMPUTING_CLIENT_SECRET
sigma_computing_client_secret.description: Sets SIGMA_COMPUTING_CLIENT_SECRET for the Sigma MCP server. Get a credential from https://help.sigmacomputing.com/reference.

sigma_computing_oauth_scope.title: SIGMA_COMPUTING_OAUTH_SCOPE
sigma_computing_oauth_scope.description: Sets SIGMA_COMPUTING_OAUTH_SCOPE for the Sigma MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.
